# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native mobile portrait voxel sandbox called **Spell Borough: Cozy Wizard City Builder**. Preserve the mechanics of a simple first-person block builder: generated terrain, D-pad movement, right-screen drag look, jump, block raycast selection, mine/place, inventory counts, pause, fall failure, and restart. Reinterpret the world as a satirical bedtime magic-school city builder inspired by wizard-school parody, fairycore, cottagecore, decora kei, cozy tycoon language, and meme cues like cute-cat energy and slay-queen feedback.

The focal identity is the unseen **Charm Mayor**, a one-thumb mobile builder zoning a cozy spell borough. Use procedural CSS/Canvas/Three.js visuals: pastel moon sky, cottage silhouettes, floating star stickers, cat-like mayor badge, golden selection charm, lawn/loam/brick textures, compact feedback overlays, and large mobile controls. Do not add new economy, enemies, timers, or win rules.

Source steering prompt: Building. A satirical game inspired by Harry Potter built around city builder play, with creative, cozy, satisfying energy, before bed session design, search-friendly hooks like city builder, building, tycoon, aesthetics like fairycore, decora kei, cottagecore, and meme-tone cues such as hello kitty, slay queen. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a mobile-first Three.js voxel sandbox. The player starts from a title overlay, enters a generated block world, moves with a left D-pad, looks with right-side drag, jumps, mines selected blocks, places selected blocks, gathers dirt/stone inventory, pauses, and fails only by falling below the world.

## Protected Mechanics
- First-person voxel traversal, gravity, jump, and collision bounds.
- Raycast block selection within short range.
- Mine/place actions, bedrock immunity, player-body placement prevention, and inventory counts.
- Start, pause/resume/quit, fall failure, and restart state flow.

## Remix Target
Spell Borough: Cozy Wizard City Builder reframes the same sandbox as a bedtime fairycore wizard mayor toy. The player builds a satirical magic-school borough with lawn charms, cocoa loam, and moon-brick while the mechanics remain unchanged.

## Runtime Spine
Canonical surface: `index.html`. Preserved reference: `index_old.html`. Engine: Three.js r160 plus inline CSS/JS and procedural Canvas textures.
